title: Design and synthesis of peptides as stabilizers of histone deacetylase 4.
authors: Lill, Annika; Schweipert, Markus; Nehls, Thomas; Wurster, Eva; Lermyte, Frederik; Meyer-Almes, Franz-Josef; Schmitz, Katja
journal: Journal of peptide science : an official publication of the European Peptide Society
one_liner_zh: 该文设计环肽稳定HDAC4蛋白构象，涉及蛋白-肽互作与分子对接，但对象为蛋白-肽而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法以实验为主，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Histone deacetylase 4 (HDAC4) contributes to gene repression by complex formation with HDAC3 and the corepressor silencing mediator for retinoid or thyroid hormone receptors (SMRT). We hypothesized that peptides derived from the class IIa specific binding site of SMRT would stabilize a specific conformation of its target protein and modulate its activity. Based on the SMRT-motif 1 (SM1) involved in the interaction of SMRT with HDAC4, we systematically developed cyclic peptides that exhibit K(i) values that are 9 to 56 times lower than that of the linear SMRT peptide. The peptide macrocycles stabilize the wildtype of the catalytic domain of HDAC4 (cHDAC4) considerably better than its thermally more stable 'gain-of-function' (GOF) variant, cHDAC4-H976Y. Molecular docking and mutagenesis studies indicated that the cyclic peptides bind in a similar but not identical manner as the linear SMRT peptide to a discontinuous binding site. Ion mobility mass spectrometry showed no major changes in the protein fold upon peptide binding. Consistent with these results, preliminary hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry measurements indicated only minor conformational changes. Taken together, the cyclic SMRT peptides most likely stabilize the apo form of cHDAC4.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶4（HDAC4）通过与HDAC3及共抑制因子维甲酸或甲状腺激素受体的沉默介导因子（SMRT）形成复合物，参与基因抑制。我们假设，源自SMRT的IIa类特异性结合位点的肽段能够稳定其靶蛋白的特定构象并调节其活性。基于参与SMRT与HDAC4相互作用的SMRT基序1（SM1），我们系统开发了环状肽，其K(i)值比线性SMRT肽低9至56倍。这些肽大环化合物对HDAC4催化域野生型（cHDAC4）的稳定作用显著优于其热稳定性更高的“功能获得性”（GOF）变体cHDAC4-H976Y。分子对接和突变研究显示，环状肽以与线性SMRT肽相似但不完全相同的方式结合到一个不连续的结合位点。离子迁移质谱分析表明，肽结合后蛋白质折叠无重大变化。与此一致，初步的氢-氘交换质谱测量仅显示微小的构象变化。综合来看，环状SMRT肽最可能稳定cHDAC4的脱辅基形式。
